criteria.criterion: AC1 - The admission cap reads from a config key defaulting to 8000, and the review guard and the new save-time warning read the SAME key (single source). (Key pre-exists: `verify.max_ticket_description_chars`.)

AC2 - On `create` and `edit` (CLI, library, MCP), when the saved description exceeds the configured cap AND the plan-review claim gate is enabled, a warning is emitted at save time stating the length, the cap, and that claim will require a passing review which refuses admission until the description is shortened. The save still succeeds.
AC3 - No warning when the gate is disabled, or when the description is within the cap; the warning never blocks or alters the write.

AC4 [operator-attested] - Verified by `pytest tests/unit/test_description_cap_warning.py`: tests cover: over-cap+gate-on warns (create and edit, each surface's channel - CLI stderr, library logger, MCP result field); over-cap+gate-off silent; under-cap silent; config key respected and default correct.

AC5 [operator-attested] - docs/config.md documents the save-time warning; verified by `make lint`, `make typecheck` and `pytest tests/unit/test_description_cap_warning.py tests/unit/test_ticket_description_limit.py`.
